**The problem / need**
What are you trying to do that Verso doesn't support well today?

**Proposed solution**
What you'd like to happen.

**Alternatives considered**
Any workarounds or other approaches.

**Scope check**
- [ ] Fits the pure-render invariant (editor output == SCORM export)
- [ ] Stays dependency-free (no new third-party runtime packages)
- [ ] Learner-facing behaviour ships in `runtime.js` / `course.css`, not editor-only

**Notes**
Do NOT include real/proprietary course content.
